recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium-close-up portrait of a man against a solid cyan-blue background, featuring a high-contrast white hand-painted script title overlaid across the chest and a clean geometric sans-serif name at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's light blue jacket harmonizes with the cyan background
Large textured script creates a foreground layer over the subject
Geometric sans-serif provides a stable base for the organic script
Soft studio lighting creates subtle depth without harsh shadows
coreInvariants: Subject looking directly at the camera

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, head and shoulders occupying the top two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large white script title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, drops to the large script title, and settles on the secondary text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space around the head against the solid color background.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and dark brown hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key brightness with medium saturation in the blues; high value contrast between text and background.

letterConstructionRules: Script: Thick, consistent monolinear strokes with rough, dry-brush edges
Sans-serif: Wide, geometric proportions with equal stroke weight
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'Y' features a long, descending tail
Script 's' includes a terminal period/dot for emphasis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Organic, textured script paired with rigid, clean geometric sans-serif for modern contrast.

preserve: Wide tracking of the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: To match the tactile, handmade feel of the main title.
To provide the clean, geometric base for the name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with dark hair wearing a light blue bomber jacket over a white t-shirt, centered against a solid cyan-blue background with soft, even lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, hand-painted textured script title across the center-chest area. Add a secondary line of text in a white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif at the bottom margin.

verificationChecks: Is the script texture visibly rough/brushed?
Is the background a consistent cyan-blue?
Is the bottom text uppercase and widely spaced?
Does the script overlap the subject's clothing?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the bottom text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brush stroke patterns in the lettering
Any brand logos or specific names

mustAchieve: Tactile feel in the display type
avoid: Tight letter spacing on the bottom text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is bright and pops against the blue.
Check that the subject's gaze is direct.
Verify the script looks hand-drawn, not like a standard digital font.
Confirm the composition is balanced and centered.
Ensure no drop shadows are used on the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Cyan Backdrop + Textured Brush Script Overlay + Geometric Sans Footer
